title: Keyboard focus trapped inside modal and cannot reach close button
body:
## Description
During a recorded session in SupportDesk, the user encountered: Keyboard focus trapped inside modal and cannot reach close button.

## Steps to Reproduce
1. Observe UI state: Help
2. Observe UI state: Support chat
3. Observe UI state: Tab

## Expected Behavior
The application should complete the user flow without errors.

## Actual Behavior
The session shows failure indicators including: Tab.

## Environment
- App: SupportDesk
- Platform: web
